subject: Save request: one-time concession & SLA uplift for MediSentry renewal
messages:
From: jonas_weber
To: marissa_cole, vivek_kulkarni
Cc: naomi_feldman
Date: 2026-12-01T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Save ask — MediSentry renewal (20% discount + 3mo credit + SLA uplift)

Team — quick one. MediSentry (annual renewal, current ARR $1.2M) just told us they received a competitive offer with a 25% effective discount and a 3-month credit. They also flagged a perceived reliability gap; procurement wants an SLA commitment at 99.99% to consider staying.

Why escalate: renewal window closes in two weeks; customer is strategic (healthcare imaging workflows) and a public reference in our roadmap material. Risk of churn right now is high.

What I recommend we offer (one-time, conditional on 12-month renewal):
- 20% net discount on year 1 (applied to invoice schedule)
- 3 months service credit to be applied as a pro-rated invoice credit for downtime > monthly SLO (to be documented in SOW)
- SLA uplift to 99.99% with defined credit tiers (legal to sign off on language)
- Provide SOC2 excerpt and usage report (attached)

Ask: need senior sign-off to approve the above concessions and authority to send a final SOW with these terms. If finance/legal want changes, I need clear guardrails (max discount, tie to commit, alternate credit structure) so I can move quickly with the customer.

Attachments: MediSentry_Renewal_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, MediSentry_Q3-usage-breakdown.xlsx, SOC2-Excerpt.pdf

Thanks — Jonas
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole
To: jonas_weber, vivek_kulkarni
Cc: naomi_feldman, dev_patel
Date: 2026-12-02T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Save ask — MediSentry renewal (20% discount + 3mo credit + SLA uplift)

Jonas — thanks for the summary. I agree this is strategic and the ask is reasonable as an exception if we can protect net revenue in year two. Two quick requests from my side before I escalate to CRO/legal:
1) Can we make the 20% a ramped concession (15% upfront, additional 5% tied to a 24-month auto-renew clause)?
2) For the 3-month credit, prefer a capped makewhole credit (e.g., up to 3 months but structured as credits against specific incident types) rather than a blanket pro-rate — reduces open-ended liability.

Vivek — can you confirm impact to margin and whether we should ask for a minimum committed seat/usage threshold?
Naomi / Dev — can you review the proposed SLA language in the attached SOW and flag any operational risks?

If we can land those edits, I will sign off and provide a one-time authority note for this deal (subject to legal sign-off on SLA wording).

-Marissa
VP Sales Ops
From: vivek_kulkarni
To: marissa_cole, jonas_weber
Cc: naomi_feldman
Date: 2026-12-03T14:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Save ask — MediSentry renewal (20% discount + 3mo credit + SLA uplift)

Marissa / Jonas — ran the numbers. If we do 20% off year 1, expected gross margin drops ~8 points for Y1 on this account. With a 12-month commit we can rebuild Y2+ to target, but we should require either a 12- or 24-month contract and a minimum committed spend of $900k/year to protect unit economics.

SLA uplift to 99.99% is feasible but must be scoped — exchanges with infra will be required for guaranteed remediation timelines and credit bands. Legal needs to see final SLA language; recommend the following constraint be included in offer copy: "SLA uplift applies only to currently supported regions and defined workloads; force majeure and scheduled maintenance windows excluded."

Also recommend the 20% be delivered as: 10% list discount + 10% one-time sign-on credit (so we preserve list pricing for comparability).

I can approve subject to:
- binding 12-month commit (minimum $900k annualized)
- SLA language with exclusions above
- Legal to sign SLA appendix

-Vivek
Head of Finance & GTM Economics
From: Lisa Choi <lisa.choi@medisentry.com>
To: jonas_weber
Date: 2026-12-08T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — MediSentry (confidential)

Jonas — appreciate the fast follow. A few clarifications from our side after internal review:
- We prefer a clean discount rather than a credit model; finance wants simplicity for audits.
- Our procurement team will not accept a 24-month auto-renew tie for an initial concession; they asked for a 12-month commitment at minimum.
- SLA language: procurement accepts the regional exclusions, but requests that scheduled maintenance be limited to a single quarterly window and that notifications are sent 30 days in advance.

We can commit to a 12-month renewal at $960k ARR if Redwood can do a 18% net discount and the 3-month credit structured as a single-line invoice credit for the first billing cycle. We also need the SOC2 excerpt and the usage report you attached for our auditors.

If you can turn that around this week we can proceed to procurement sign-off.

Thanks — Lisa
Head of IT Procurement, MediSentry
From: marissa_cole
To: jonas_weber, vivek_kulkarni, dev_patel
Cc: naomi_feldman
Date: 2026-12-15T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: FINAL — Senior clearance for MediSentry one-time concession

Folks — after back-and-forth with the customer, the counter from MediSentry is: 18% net discount + single-line 3-month invoice credit, 12-month firm commitment at $960k ARR, and the limited maintenance window request. Jonas confirmed SOC2 excerpt/usage report delivered.

Per my review and Vivek's economics note, I'm granting one-time senior clearance to accept the customer counter with these guardrails: 
- 18% net discount structured as 9% list discount + 9% one-time credit applied on first invoice
- 3-month credit issued as a single invoice credit applied to the first billing cycle (cap applies; legal will document limits in SLA appendix)
- 12-month commitment at $960k ARR required before concessions are applied
- SLA uplift language must include the maintenance-window exclusion and 30-day notice requirement; legal to finalize appendix

Jonas — you have authority to send the updated SOW and get the customer's signature. Copy me when signed and route final SOW to legal for appendix sign-off. This authority is one-time for this renewal only.

-Marissa
VP Sales Ops


Quoted/forwarded headers are preserved above where relevant.
